standard_prerequisites.name: Definition of a divided power structure
standard_prerequisites.use: Axioms (1)-(5) whose generator-local validity is propagated.

core_obligations: Use axiom (3) to propagate (2) and (5) from generators to ax times generators, reducing (b) to a set of abelian-group generators.
Induct on expression length: it suffices to handle x + y when (2) and (5) hold for x and y.
Prove (2) for x + y by expanding with (4) and reducing to a universal rational identity, justified by the Q[x,y] model gamma_n(f) = f^n/n!.
Prove (5) for x + y by expanding gamma_n(gamma_m(x+y)) into universal integer coefficients c_ij and identifying them in the same Q[x,y] model.
proof_roadmap: Propagate by axiom (3), induct on word length, and close both remaining axioms by the polynomial-identity trick in Q[x,y] with all coefficients universal.
difficulty_reason: The binomial-coefficient bookkeeping is mechanical once the Q[x,y] reduction is made; no construction beyond the expansion.
